pages.text: Checks if a lever is on.$(br2)A block that is not a lever raises INVALID_ARGUMENT.
$(li)$(1)position$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: where the lever is$(li)result $(1)result$() BOOLEAN: true if the lever is on
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/GET_LEVER$(br)  PARAMETER position lever ;$(br)  RESULT result isOn$()
